verdict.rationale: Riveter's documentation covers enrichment, scraping, search, scheduling and webhooks, but nothing in the evidence discusses handling large tables, chunking strategies, or processing-limit management for big datasets — the closest is pagination for API results, which is unrelated to extraction chunking. Missing for 10: any mention of large-table handling, row/batch chunking logic, size-limit thresholds, or performance benchmarks on big data.
